title: The Age of Spiritual Machines
subtitle: When Computers Exceed Human Intelligence
pitch: Kurzweil's early case that computing power grows exponentially and that machines will match human intelligence around 2029, with dated predictions you can check.

chapters.g: Why intelligence on Earth keeps speeding up.

chapters.t: The law of time and chaos
chapters.g: His idea that the pace of change speeds up as order grows.
Evolution as a slow process that produced fast minds.
What thinking and consciousness might mean for machines.

chapters.t: A new form of intelligence on earth
chapters.g: Computers as a new kind of intelligence that can grow without limit.
Why knowledge and context matter for intelligence.
Ways to build brain level machines, including reverse engineering the brain.
The state of technology as he saw it at the time.
Predictions for 2009: portable computers everywhere, speech input and more.
Predictions for 2019, including computers with human level processing power.
Machines that pass for human and claim to be conscious.
A merger of humans and machines.

chapters.t: Epilogue: The rest of the universe revisited
chapters.g: Intelligence spreading out into the universe.

ideas: The law of accelerating returns: progress speeds up exponentially.
Machines will match human intelligence around 2029.
Humans will merge with their technology.
Dated predictions let readers check the forecast.

args.a: Exponential trends make human level AI by 2029 likely.
args.c: Some predictions came true, many came late or differently. Critics say trend lines cannot tell you about missing breakthroughs.

args.a: Merging with machines is the natural next step.
args.c: Others see risks to identity, equality and control in such a merger.

questions: Pick one of his 2019 predictions. Did it come true?
Does progress really speed up, or does it come in bursts?
Would you want to merge with a machine?

quiz.q: Around what year did Kurzweil predict human level machine intelligence?
quiz.w: He has kept that date for decades.

quiz.q: What is the law of accelerating returns?
o: The idea that technological progress speeds up exponentially

quiz.q: How is the future part organised?
